in_hebrew.name: זופניה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זופניה הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הסתירני' או 'אלוהים שמרני'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'זופן' שפירושו 'להסתיר' או 'לשמור', ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם נמצא בספר צפניה שבתנ'ך, שם צפניה הוא נביא שפעל בימי מלך יאשיהו של יהודה.

in_greek.name: Ζοφονίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζοφονίας είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός κρύβει' ή 'ο Θεός φυλάσσει'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'זופן' που σημαίνει 'να κρύβω' ή 'να φυλάσσω' και 'אל' που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Στο Χρηστικό κείμενο, το όνομα Ζοφονίας αναφέρεται στο βιβλίο του προφήτη Ζοφονίας στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη.

in_latin.name: Zophania
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zophania significat 'Deus absconditus' vel 'Deus conservans'. Etymologia nominis hebraica est, ex vocibus 'זופן' quod 'abscondere' vel 'conservare' significat et 'אל' quod est 'Deus'. In traditione christiana, nomen Zophania in libro prophetae Zophaniae in Veteri Testamento invenitur.

in_english.name: Zophania
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zophania is of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God hides' or 'God protects'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'zofan,' meaning 'to hide' or 'to protect,' and 'El,' meaning 'God.' The name is found in the book of Zephaniah in the Old Testament, where Zephaniah is a prophet who ministered during the reign of King Josiah of Judah. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify a close relationship with God, implying protection and care. It symbolizes spiritual guardianship and divine oversight.

biblical_reference.note: Zephaniah was a prophet in the Old Testament who foretold the judgment of God on Judah and the surrounding nations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zophania holds great significance in Christian culture, especially during times of adversity and hardship. data.spiritual_significance: The name Zophania holds great spiritual significance for Christians, representing the idea of God's hiddenness and divine protection. In the Bible, God frequently uses prophets like Zophania to speak His message to His people. The name Zophania can be seen as a reminder that God is always with us, even when we may not be able to see or understand His plan. It serves as a reminder that God is collecting us and keeping us safe, even in the midst of challenges and difficult times. The name Zophania can be a source of comfort and strength for those feeling lost or overlooked, reminding them that God never abandons or forgets His people.

historical_references.reference: Biblical name of a woman mentioned in the Old Testament. She is the wife of Abiud, a descendant of King David.
